title: Dolphins OC Bobby Slowik: Malik Willis's running ability "lets you equalize some advantageous situations"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dolphins OC Bobby Slowik: Malik Willis's running ability "lets you equalize some advantageous situations"
sources.description: When Dolphins offensive coordinator Bobby Slowik was asked at a Tuesday press conference about the things that excite him about quarterback Malik Willis, he began his answer by saying Willis "can spin the ball all over the field."
